comment: Fri 08:48 UTC, London morning. Buy at 1.16113, about 2.5 pips under the 13:42 PKT lower high, inside a 2-hour box (the last 120 candles span only 8.2 ATR). It never ticked up: -23 pips in 27 min, stop-out, best_R -0.01. Caught by range_bound120 and chop120; neither holds on the base test half.

Mon 08:00:03 UTC, three seconds into the London 08:00 candle. Buy into a triple top (1.1564-1.15645) after a 29-pip two-hour climb (run120 29, mv60 +18). Its twin 0309-075007-B bought the same top 10 min earlier and got its 0.1 pip before the same collapse: same chart, only the first ticks differed. Caught by extended_run120, with_move60, news_clock, chop120 (and the random control).

Wed 12:02 UTC, NY pre-open. Buy at 1.15472, a lower high 2.3 pips under the 16:20 PKT top, after a volume-spike sell-off from that top; the 2-hour box was tight (9.1 ATR). Stop-out in 23 min without one uptick. Caught by range_bound120 and news_clock.

Thu 02:27 UTC, Asia. Buy at the top of a 15-pip spike (07:07 PKT, 550-tick bar) after 20 min of sideways drift, 1.5 pips under the spike high (pos120 0.95, run120 24). Drifted 2 h, then stopped out. Caught by extended_run120, with_move60, news_clock - the extension family whose O/E effect vanishes against the path-free null.

Thu 18:49 UTC (14:49 NY). Sell at the floor of a flat 90-min box (1.1555-1.1560); within minutes a 20-pip NY-afternoon rally took the stop (8.5 min). Nothing at decision time stands out (120-bar range 25 ATR, normal spread, quiet volume). No rule catches it.

Fri 20:01 UTC (16:01 NY, thin post-close tape). The breakout tick printed 1.2 pips past the level (a jump), the buy filled at that spike top, and the engine flattened it at the weekly close for -$136 (why=8, not a stop-out). A Friday-close artefact: its MT5 value depends on whether the EA flattens like the sim. Caught by news_clock and chop120.

Wed 07:56 UTC, London open. Buy at 1.1699 = the 12:51 PKT high (a double top) after a 20-pip climb from the 12:11 low (run120 20). Stopped in 46 min, never ticked up. Caught by extended_run120, news_clock, chop120.

Thu 06:28 UTC. Sell one bar after a fresh two-hour low (1.16541): the UHV was the green bounce candle off that low and the level sat 1.3 pips above it (pos120 0.92) - selling into stopping volume. Its twin 0409-062132-S sold the same slide 7 min earlier with the same picture and won. Caught only by news_clock.

Thu 11:03 UTC. Same picture as 0409-062811-S: a capitulation red bar to a new low (1.16695), a green UHV bounce, the sell level 2 pips above the low in a tight box (7.7 ATR); price climbed 13 pips over 2 h. Caught by range_bound120 and news_clock.

Mon 12:09 UTC, NY pre-open. Sell at the bottom of a 15-pip slide (mv60 +15) one bar after a V-bounce off 1.16803, at a congested price (7 swing lows within 1 pip), spread 0.7 pip - the widest in the zone. The most-flagged loss: range_bound120, with_move60, congested_level, chop120, wide_spread_now.

Tue 06:25 UTC. Sell into a double bottom (1.17595 at 10:33 PKT, 1.1758 at 11:22 PKT; pos120 0.95, 10 swing lows within 1 pip): the green UHV was the second bounce; rallied 15 pips. Its ER16 0.349 sits INSIDE Zee's 0.30-0.35 band - only its 4 humps keep it out of zee100. Caught by congested_level and news_clock.

Wed 08:25 UTC, London. Buy 2 bars after a fresh spike high (1.17952 at 13:21 PKT), the level 1.2 pips under it (pos120 0.90) - buying the top of the spike. Stopped over 2 h. Caught by news_clock and chop120.

Fri 19:16 UTC (15:16 NY, Friday afternoon). A 3-hump bounce inside a 23-pip sell-off (mv60 -8): the buy level was the bounce high, spread 0.7 pip; the slide resumed. Counter to the 2-hour move, but the earlier study's counter-trend rule failed on base. Caught by wide_spread_now (and the random control).

Tue 11:13 UTC. Buy about 1.5 pips under a 5-pip spike candle's high (16:05 PKT), which was also the 14:50 PKT high (a double top), in a tight 2-hour box (8.1 ATR). Fell 20 pips in an hour. Caught by range_bound120.

Tue 14:57:39 UTC (10:57 NY), 2 min before the hour: a mid-range sell in a 90-min box (1.1691-1.1703; 5.3 ATR, the tightest of the 30). A 15-pip rally started at 15:00 UTC; stopped after 7 h. Caught by range_bound120, congested_level, news_clock, chop120 (and the random control).

Tue 11:17 UTC. Buy at the top of a 2.5-hour box: the level 1.16436 is the 15:28 PKT high zone, turned back 11 times (congested), box only 8.0 ATR, ATR 1.0 pip. Fell 10 pips in 2.5 h. Caught by range_bound120 and congested_level.

Wed 12:36 UTC, six minutes after the 12:30 UTC US data spike (+25 pips in 15 min; ATR 4.3 pips, the highest of the 30): a buy at the spike's double top. Stopped over 2 h. Caught by range_bound120, extended_run120, with_move60.

Thu 01:15 UTC, quiet Asia (ATR 0.9). Buy inside a sleepy range, 3 pips under its high; nothing at decision time stands out (pos120 0.32, normal spread). The market drifted down 8 pips over 2 h - 30% of random same-side entries in that window lost too. No rule catches it.

Tue 03:03 UTC, dead Asia (ATR 0.54, the quietest of the 30). Sell after a 2-pip poke at a congested price (10 swing lows within 1 pip); a slow grind up took 3.5 h to reach the stop. Caught by congested_level, news_clock, chop120.

Thu 07:46 UTC, London open. Sell at the bottom of an exhausted slide - humps 5 and ER16 0.45, both on the secure zone's upper edges - one bar after a capitulation low (1.1598), the UHV being the green bounce. Caught by with_move60; the tight zone (humps <= 3, ER < 0.45) already excludes it.

Fri 01:30:41 UTC, the 01:30 Asian data minute. Sell on a V-reversal off a fresh low in a choppy Asian box (5.2 ATR), at an extremely congested price (42 swing lows within 1 pip). Caught by range_bound120, congested_level, news_clock.

Mon 01:48 UTC, Asia. Buy at an old pivot (1.1468) off a UHV 17 bars old, above the 7-bar range (box 20), after a 10-pip climb (mv60 +9.7). A slow 6-hour bleed to the stop. Caught by with_move60 (and the random control).

Thu 00:37 UTC, Asia (ATR 0.77). Sell one bar after a fresh low at the end of a spike-and-fall, humps 5 (exhausted), at a congested price (29 swing lows within 1 pip). Ground up for 6 h. Caught by congested_level (and the random control); the tight zone (humps <= 3) excludes it.
Mon 14:49 UTC (10:49 NY). Sell at the floor of a 2-hour box (the 18:58 PKT low 1.14085 sits 3 pips below), spread 0.0. Rallied 8 pips. Caught by chop120 only (and the random control).

Wed 13:29:37 UTC, 23 s before the 09:30 New York stock open. A 2-hump red pullback inside a strong 2-hour up-move (mv60 -12): the sell level 1.1424 is the old 17:32 PKT breakout pivot (resistance turned support). Caught by news_clock (and the random control).

Mon 14:00:12 UTC = 10:00:12 New York, the US data minute: the sell tick came 12 s into a 520-tick bar (double the average) and the release rallied it to the stop. Caught by range_bound120, congested_level, news_clock, wide_spread_now - the clearest news-clock loss, yet the clock windows do not hold as a rule.

Fri 12:19 UTC, eleven minutes before the 12:30 UTC US data (first Friday of October, likely payrolls). Sold the bottom of a 20-pip slide (humps 5, run120 20); the 12:30 spike jumped through the stop (-1.51R, -$323, the biggest loss). A calendar would have blocked it; the bars cannot. Caught by range_bound120, extended_run120, with_move60 (and the random control).

Tue 05:11 UTC (ATR 0.81). Sell at the base of a 4-pip spike (10:01 PKT): the level 1.1172 is the old range ceiling (21 swing lows within 1 pip), the UHV 9 bars old, below the 7-bar range (box 20). Caught by range_bound120 and congested_level.

Mon 17:13 UTC (13:13 NY). Sell exactly into a double bottom: the level 1.12071 is the 21:49 PKT low (1.12070). Took 9.7 h to stop out. This is the ER16 0.352 tight loss sitting just above Zee's 0.35 cut - the zee100 edge was drawn right under it. No rule catches it.

Fri 14:50 UTC (10:50 NY). Buy into a triple top (1.12057-1.12077, 19:07-19:23 PKT); ER16 0.44 at the zone's top edge. Its twin 1023-141514-B bought the same level 35 min earlier and got its 0.1 pip at once. Flattened at the Friday close for -$40 (why=8). Caught by with_move60, chop120, wide_spread_now.
